items.rationale: Heterozygous C/T is the only genotype either cohort observed; every carrier in both studies was heterozygous. C/C was deliberately not authored: Hirvonen's discussion argues a positive CC effect, but that is an inference from the same 2x2 table rather than a separate observation, so authoring it would double-count one test. T/T was observed in neither cohort although gnomAD records 183 homozygotes globally. Both omissions are written up as open decisions in the README. items.rationale: Neither study reached its own significance threshold: p = 0.074 in the Finnish combined test and p = 0.073 across the Iranian age strata. Both author teams nevertheless frame the result as a directional trend worth following up. Suggestive is the closest honest value in the vocabulary; not_significant is a defensible alternative and is flagged in the README as a reviewer's call. The Iranian paper's primary frailty hypothesis was null and is not carried as a claim.
